translations.text: He called the third man and said to him, “Look, I accept your testimony above that of many others. Who took Jesus’ body from the tomb?” He said to him, “It was Joseph and Nicodemus, together with all their relatives.”
If they had taken the body, they would have taken the shroud with it.
But the wrath of his anger is coming upon you.
They submitted themselves to the judgment, saying, “His blood and his death be upon us forever.”

Pilate said to the centurion, “My brother, do not put the true stone that you have taken out onto the scales in support of the lies and hatred of the Jews.” Then he turned [?] the Jews and said to them, “You people [?]”
[?] Pilate and the centurion at the water well in the garden, which was very deep.

I am Gamaliel, and I too was following him in the company. They looked down into the water well and saw the dead man floating on one side of the well. The Jews cried out, “Pilate, look, here is the magician [?] like [?]”
For this reason he called the leaders of the Jews.
He said to them, “Do you really believe that this is the Nazarene?” They said to him, “We believe it.”
He said to them, “It is fitting to put his body in his tomb and let it decay like all the dead.” Then he called Joseph and Nicodemus again and said to them, “[?]”
